# Persistence pitfalls

Read before touching stored data: stores, journals, saves, JSON loaders and migrations. The friend server can never be wiped, so every stored-format change needs a migration that runs at start, every on-disk state must load or self-repair (never refuse forever), no receipt is lost and no loot is duplicated. Saves go through HCSaveScheduler and the staged writer, one native file operation per step.

Skill: `hc-persistence`. Rule ids come from `tools/validate/enforce_lint.py` and `tools/validate/enforce_perf.py`; each rule or cited comment appears on exactly one card.

## Lint and perf rules

| Rule | What it rejects |
|---|---|
| HC-E010 | integer assigned to a FileHandle (native compile: Incompatible parameter); track open state in a bool |
| HC-E016 | FileHandle/FindFileHandle compared with null (use truthiness) |
| HC-E017 | vanilla storage override without an explicit migration-plan allowlist entry |
| HC-P003 | file I/O reachable in one tick/save step outside the staged writer |
| HC-P008 | synchronous store Save reachable on a tick path |
| HC-P009 | synchronous multi-file loop reachable from OnStart |
| HC-S005 | JSON-loaded scalar has a nonzero initializer but no explicit zero/default guard |

## Native failures cited in the code

Comments under `mods/` that cite a build or issue and say what failed. Open the file before changing the code they describe.


### `mods/HollowCountry/scripts/4_World/Infected/HCInfectedState.c`

- Stops native route intent. HCInfectedPolicy.ValidRouteMetadata requires an active route for an in-progress result (1), so stopping one records it as interrupted (5), as HCNativeInfectedPack.Release and restart recovery already do. Build 151 saved a retired reinforcement with result 1 and no route; Validate refused the snapshot.

### `mods/HollowCountry/scripts/4_World/World/HCWorkBudget.c`

- 8 * (HCGroupIO.HC_RAW_READ_CAP 8388608 / HC_CHUNK_BYTES 4096) + 128. Keep a literal: a cross-class static const expression read as 0 natively (build 169 boot: Leads Save exhausted a 6-step guard, lead_store_unavailable).
- Crash recovery for the primary-wins stores (#336): a hard stop after the primary was promoted and before clear_intent leaves path.tmp byte-identical to path. Returns true only after deleting such a .tmp; every other case returns false and touches nothing, so the
- Crash-safe publish chain whose caller waits on it (event journal). Dispatched before every other job, including other urgent ones, at stage boundaries (issue #333).

### `mods/HollowCountry/scripts/4_World/World/HCWorldStore.c`

- Finishes or drops a save interrupted by a crash or hard stop (#237). Each HCStagedSaveImage.HCStepImage boundary leaves one of these on disk: write_tmp: partial intent, old primary and backup untouched -> drop intent;
